# S. Sathish Kumar

> S. Sathish Kumar (Joe) is the Founder & CEO of Queen Touch Technology (QTT), an IT and digital solutions company based in Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu, India. He is a technology strategist and IT leader with over a decade of experience in enterprise software, IT projects, digital transformation, and technology solutions. He is open to global remote collaborations and professional opportunities.
